name: current-events
description: Short event polling with a dynamically issued token and boot ID. The Vespera status producer additively permits telemetry.adapter_yielded with instrument_id, adapter_id vespera_status_v1 and retry_after 600; tests/test_telemetry_vespera.py executes the producer and validates its real HTTP event against the contract. The Seestar events producer additively permits adapter_id seestar_events_v1 for telemetry.adapter_yielded and telemetry.adapter_refused with that adapter_id; tests/test_telemetry_seestar.py validates actual producer events over native HTTP.

steps.note: An empty snapshot emits no synthetic service checks. The service probe also permits service_changed for a changed bounded service result; associated/ready retain their legacy meanings. Hotspot supervision additionally permits hotspot_unavailable (HOTSPOT_RADIO_UNAVAILABLE or HOTSPOT_START_FAILED) and hotspot_restored (HOTSPOT_RESTORED), with profile_id hotspot, empty profile_name and no raw network identifiers. Their associated/ready booleans describe the confirmed AP, not an instrument. Clock correction permits clock_status synchronized and optional utc_corrected when a correction exists; timestamps never determine order.
